title: ReviewInputRefusal::into_api_error uses unreachable! on request paths; make it exhaustive
outcome: ReviewInputRefusal::into_api_error (src/delegation_review_input.rs ~327) has no unreachable!("handled above") arm. It runs on the submission and publication-fence request paths, so a future variant that missed both match levels would panic a handler instead of returning an ApiError. Replace the arm with an exhaustive inner match with no wildcard, or with a generic fallback message.
acceptance: into_api_error contains no unreachable!/panic arm and every variant maps to an ApiError; cargo check is clean.
